$comment: Familista Cyber Defense — the reviewed security posture. The manifest (generated/security-manifest.json) says what the code IS; this file says what has been REVIEWED and accepted. tests/security-posture.unit.test.ts fails when the two disagree. Changing this file is a security review: say why in the commit.

publicRoutes.POST /auth/register: Refused for everybody (Final Security Closure, Task 1): 403 SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED before the body is read. Kept public so the answer is a clear refusal rather than a sign-in prompt; accounts come only from a club's invitation.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/login: Credential exchange; no session can exist yet. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/login/mfa: The second sign-in step; no session can exist yet. Authenticated by a single-use, hashed, five-minute challenge from the password step. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/refresh: Authenticated by the refresh token presented, not by an access token. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/logout: Revokes the presented refresh token; must work with an expired access token. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/forgot-password: Starts a reset for a reader who cannot sign in. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.GET /auth/reset-password/:token/validate: Authenticated by the reset token in the path. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.POST /auth/reset-password: Authenticated by the reset token in the body. Behind the auth rate limiter.
publicRoutes.GET /billing/plans: Public price list; returns no account data.
publicRoutes.POST /billing/webhook: Stripe calls it; authenticated by the Stripe-Signature header (stripe.webhooks.constructEvent) over the raw body.
publicRoutes.GET /invitations/preview: Shows an invitation before anybody signs in; authenticated by the invitation token.
publicRoutes.POST /invitations/accept-with-account: Creates the invited account; authenticated by the invitation token.
publicRoutes.POST /devices/auth/token: Device handshake: device-auth service requires deviceSessionId, ts, nonce and an HMAC signature before issuing a device token.
publicRoutes.POST /device-infra/devices/by-serial/:se: First activation of a provisioned device: device-registry verifies an HMAC over ts.nonce with the device credential (timingSafeEqual).
publicRoutes.POST /devices/sessions/:id/packets: acceptUserOrDevice: requires a user JWT or a device JWT; the scanner does not recognise that guard by name.
publicRoutes.POST /devices/sessions/:id/packets/batch: acceptUserOrDevice: requires a user JWT or a device JWT; the scanner does not recognise that guard by name.
publicRoutes.POST /devices/:id([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-f: acceptUserOrDevice: device-keyed alias of the packet ingest; requires a user JWT or a device JWT.
publicRoutes.POST /neuro/streams/:id/event-batch: Edge camera ingest: HMAC over the batch verified with the camera credential, nonce replay-checked (device-nonce service).
publicRoutes.POST /vision/cameras/:id/frame: Edge camera ingest: HMAC over ts.nonce.sha256(detections) verified with the camera credential.
publicRoutes.GET /phase-q/video/shared/:shareToken: A shared clip link: the 192-bit random share token in the path is the credential, and the service refuses an unknown or expired token. Returns that one clip only.
publicRoutes.GET /matches/:id/live: Live match stream (SSE). Not anonymous: EventSource cannot send headers, so the handler verifies a user JWT from ?token= itself and checks the match's club. Known weaknesses tracked elsewhere: the token travels in the URL (websocket-token-outside-url) and session revocation is not checked on realtime channels (remediation R1c).

appLevelRoutes.GET /api/health: Liveness probe for the load balancer; returns no data.
appLevelRoutes.GET /healthz: Liveness probe for the load balancer; returns no data.
appLevelRoutes.GET /app/*: Serves the static single-page shell; data is fetched with a session afterwards.
appLevelRoutes.GET /invite: Serves the static invitation page shell.
appLevelRoutes.GET /invite/*: Serves the static invitation page shell.
appLevelRoutes.GET /reset-password: Serves the static password-reset page shell.
appLevelRoutes.POST /internal/backups/run: Scheduled backup trigger for .github/workflows/backup.yml. No session by design: authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 (BACKUP_TRIGGER_SECRET) over method, path and timestamp, 5-minute window, constant-time; closed when the secret is unset; takes no body or query; rate-limited; one run at a time; none within 12 hours of a success.
appLevelRoutes.GET /internal/backups/runs/:id: Status of one scheduled backup run, same HMAC authentication and rate limit; answers only id, state, start and finish times and ok.
appLevelRoutes.POST /internal/video/transcode-callback: Transcode result from an external transcode worker (R1a). No session by design, and no user token opens it: authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 (VIDEO_WORKER_CALLBACK_SECRET) over method, path, timestamp and the raw body, 5-minute window, constant-time; closed when the secret is unset; rate-limited; strict body schema; the service refuses any storage key outside the asset's own club folder. The in-process transcode worker calls the service directly and never uses this route.

dormantRouteModules.admin-dashboard.routes: Not mounted. Must not be mounted without a security review.
dormantRouteModules.admin.routes: Not mounted. Must not be mounted without a security review.
dormantRouteModules.ai-engine.routes: Not mounted. Must not be mounted without a security review.
dormantRouteModules.executive.routes: Not mounted. Its executor synthesises a PLATFORM_ADMIN principal with MFA marked verified; must be reviewed before any mount.
dormantRouteModules.franchise.routes: Not mounted. Must not be mounted without a security review.
dormantRouteModules.investor.routes: Not mounted. Must not be mounted without a security review.
dormantRouteModules.vision-engine.routes: Not mounted. Must not be mounted without a security review.
dormantRouteModules.whitelabel.routes: Not mounted. Must not be mounted without a security review.

outboundCallSites.src/platform/email/providers/sendgrid.ts: Fixed host api.sendgrid.com; nothing in the request line comes from a user.
outboundCallSites.src/security/outbound-url-guard.ts: The guard itself (R1b): the only path for a URL a user supplied — public https addresses only, checked at the connection, no redirects, bounded time and size, no response body kept.
outboundCallSites.src/services/vision-clip.adapter.ts: Operator-configured endpoint (VISION_CLIP_WORKER_URL); users supply only ids, which are URL-encoded path segments.
outboundCallSites.src/services/vision-inference.adapter.ts: Operator-configured endpoint (VISION_WORKER_URL); users supply only ids, which are URL-encoded path segments.
outboundCallSites.src/workers/notification-dispatch.worker: WEBHOOK targets are user-supplied and go only through the outbound guard; EMAIL/SMS/PUSH use operator-configured provider URLs from the environment, with redirects not followed and no response body kept.

realtimeEndpoints.src/realtime/match-sse.ts: Live match stream: verifySessionToken on open, watchSession while open; the stream is ended when the session ends.
realtimeEndpoints.src/realtime/match-ws.ts: Match WebSocket: verifySessionToken on upgrade, watchSession while open; closed with 4401 when the session ends.
realtimeEndpoints.src/realtime/market-ws.ts: Market WebSocket: verifySessionToken on upgrade, watchSession while open; closed with 4401 when the session ends.
realtimeEndpoints.src/routes/data-pulse.routes.ts: Owner data-pulse stream behind authenticate; watchRequestSession ends it when the session ends.
realtimeEndpoints.src/routes/infrastructure.routes.ts: Owner infrastructure stream behind authenticate; watchRequestSession ends it when the session ends.
realtimeEndpoints.src/routes/owner-trace.routes.ts: Owner trace stream behind authenticate; watchRequestSession ends it when the session ends.
realtimeEndpoints.src/services/vision-realtime.service.ts: Vision stream writer; its only caller (vision-engine.controller, dormant route) calls watchRequestSession before handing it the response.

knownGaps.mfa-required-at-login: PARTIAL — required at sign-in for an owner who switched it on (Step 7) and, while MFA_REQUIRED_FOR_ADMINS=true, for administrators (R7); not required for every account.
knownGaps.refresh-token-legacy-fallback-removed: ABSENT — the nullable legacy token column and the dual-read fallback stay until every pre-Step-8 refresh token has expired; removing them is a later cleanup.

ai-ops.routes :agent.reason: An agent kind (enum token), not a row id; the job created is stamped with the caller's club.

ai-ops.routes :id.reason: ai-ops service ack/resolve/mute/getReport take {userId, clubId, role} and compare the row's club; GET /jobs/:id compares the job's club inline in the controller.

ai.routes :id.reason: aiService.analyzePlayer(id, caller's clubId) reads the player within the caller's club.

auth.routes :token.reason: A password-reset token, validated by passwordResetService; it names no club row.

automation.routes :id.reason: automation.service getTask/listRuns(id, caller's clubId) call assertTaskInClub; update/delete/trigger/cancel take the caller and do the same.

billing-j.routes :deviceId.reason: billing-j service listDevicePlans takes the caller and compares the device's club.

club.routes :clubId.reason: ensureClubAccess (route middleware) refuses a club other than the caller's unless SUPER_ADMIN.

coaches.routes :clubId.reason: coachesClubTeams takes the caller and returns only what the caller's role may see of that club.

coaches.routes :entryId.reason: deleteCareerEntry: assertEmploys on the staff member, and the entry must belong to that staff member.

coaches.routes :staffUserId.reason: Coaches writes call assertEmploys(caller, staffUserId): only the employing club may change its staff.

coaches.routes :trophyId.reason: deleteTrophy: assertEmploys on the staff member, and the trophy must belong to that staff member's profile.

device-infra.routes :serial.reason: Device activation by serial: activateDevice requires the device's eFuse fingerprint, a signature, a timestamp within 5 minutes and a nonce; no club row is read for a user by the serial.

device-session.routes :id.reason: device-session.service getSession/listPackets(id, caller's clubId), closeSession/ingestPacket/ingestBatch(caller) compare the session's club; the UUID packet route and acceptUserOrDevice routes are authenticated by the device's own signed token.

fabric.routes :clubId.reason: fabric.routes is behind assertPlatformOwner; the platform owner reads any club's history summary by design.

familista-league.routes :fixtureId.reason: League fixtures are read by all participants; rescheduling requires assertLeagueAdmin.

familista-league.routes :teamId.reason: The Familista League is a platform competition: every participating club reads every team's record; removal requires assertLeagueAdmin.

familista-vision.routes :id.reason: withSession loads the session and answers 404 unless maySeeSession (vision-platform/vision-access.ts): the platform owner, or a viewer whose club is the session's club.

infrastructure.routes :id.reason: Infrastructure City is behind assertPlatformOwner; incidents and components are platform objects, not club rows.

intelligence.routes :jobId.reason: intelligence Svc.getJob takes the caller and compares the job's club.

invitation.routes :id.reason: invitation.service resendInvitation/revokeInvitation take the caller and compare the invitation's club.

match-center.routes :fixtureId.reason: Match Center fixtures are league fixtures between clubs; fixtureAccess decides what each side may do, and change requests are limited to the two clubs.

match-center.routes :requestId.reason: A change request is between the two clubs of a fixture; actOnRequest allows only the other side or a league admin.

match.routes :annotationId.reason: annotation.service updateAnnotation/deleteAnnotation take the caller and compare the annotation's club.

match.routes :eventId.reason: The match is guarded by router.param('id'); match-intelligence editTimelineEvent/deleteTimelineEvent take the caller and the match id and check the event belongs to that match.

membership.routes :id.reason: membership.service changeRole/changeTeam/suspend/reactivate/revoke take the caller and compare the membership's club.

neuro.routes :id.reason: POST /streams/:id/event-batch is registered before authenticate: event cameras push batches signed with the stream's own key, verified by event-stream.service ingestEventBatch.

neuro.routes :kind.reason: A detector kind (FORMATION, PRESSING, …); the match beside it is guarded by tenantParam('match').

neuro.routes :memberId.reason: The rig is guarded by tenantParam('cameraRig'); camera-rig.service removeMember refuses a member whose rigId is not that rig.

phase-l.routes :jobId.reason: Federated training jobs span clubs by design and have no single owning club. Since Batch 5 (R8) a gradient is accepted only from a club the platform owner has trusted and that has allowed training use, and a round is aggregated only by the club that started it or the platform owner — both checked in federated.service.

phase-o.routes :id.reason: operations/lifecycle/governance/monitoring services unlinkGuardian, setPaymentState, transitionContractState, transitionRequestState, setAlertRuleState take the caller and compare the row's club.

phase-o.routes :sessionId.reason: DELETE /auth/sessions/:sessionId: session.service revoke allows the owner, SUPER_ADMIN, or a CLUB_ADMIN of the user's own club (assertMayEndSessionsOf, R2). GET /ops/attendance/training/:sessionId: operations.service compares the session's club.

phase-o.routes :userId.reason: session.service revokeAllForUser allows the user, SUPER_ADMIN, or a CLUB_ADMIN of the user's own club (assertMayEndSessionsOf, R2).

phase-p.routes :id.reason: Inbox items are the caller's own notifications: inbox markRead/archive match on the caller's userId.

phase-q.routes :annotationId.reason: video-annotation.service update/delete take the caller and compare the annotation's club.

phase-q.routes :assetId.reason: video-asset.service getAsset/getStreamUrl/streamHlsFile/deleteAsset take the caller and compare the asset's club.

phase-q.routes :clipId.reason: video-clip/annotation services take the caller and compare the clip's club.

phase-q.routes :competitionId.reason: competition.service _assertCompOwner refuses another club's competition (getCompetition, getStandings, rebuild, add/remove team, round robin); listFixtures filters by the caller's clubId.

phase-q.routes :filename.reason: An HLS segment file name inside the asset guarded beside it (confined to the asset's own folder).

phase-q.routes :fixtureId.reason: competition.service _assertFixtureOwner refuses another club's fixture (update, result, cancel).

phase-q.routes :id.reason: match-event.service deleteEvent takes the caller and compares the event's club.

phase-q.routes :injuryId.reason: workload-science.service injury reads and writes take the caller and compare the injury's club.

phase-q.routes :matchId.reason: match-event.service listEvents/getEventSummary load the match and refuse another club's; the video summary composes those and the club-filtered asset/clip lists.

phase-q.routes :playlistId.reason: video-clip.service playlist operations take the caller and compare the playlist's club.

phase-q.routes :position.reason: A playing position (GK, CB, …); the candidates are read within the caller's club.

phase-q.routes :reportId.reason: scouting service report reads and writes take the caller and compare the report's club.

phase-q.routes :shareToken.reason: A public share token for a clip the owning club chose to share (declared public route).

phase-q.routes :targetId.reason: scouting service transfer-target writes take the caller and compare the target's club.

phase-q.routes :teamId.reason: workload squadReadiness and competition removeTeamFromCompetition take the caller and check the team/competition belong to the caller's club.

predictive.routes :id.reason: predictAll(matchId, caller's clubId) loads the match and refuses another club's with ForbiddenError.

provisioning.routes :certId.reason: provisioning.service revokeCert takes the caller and compares the certificate's device club.

provisioning.routes :deviceId.reason: provisioning.service listCertsForDevice takes the caller and compares the device's club.

provisioning.routes :id.reason: provisioning.service getBatch/materialiseBatch take the caller and compare the batch's club.

provisioning.routes :releaseId.reason: OTA releases are platform-wide rows with no club; creating and advancing them requires requirePlatformAuthority (platform owner or SUPER_ADMIN) since Batch 3 (R11). Before that, any CLUB_ADMIN could.

scouting.routes :prospectId.reason: scouting.service prospect reads and writes take the caller and compare the prospect's club.

sources.routes :id.reason: Source Core is behind assertPlatformOwner; a source id names a platform data source, not a club row.

spatial.routes :id.reason: buildSpatialFrame/twinAt/listAnchors(matchId, caller's clubId) load the match and compare its club.

staff-market.routes :approachId.reason: An approach is between two clubs (and the staff member); staff-market.service lets only its parties act.

staff-market.routes :needId.reason: staff-market.service closeNeed takes the caller and compares the need's club.

staff-market.routes :staffUserId.reason: The staff market shows staff across clubs by design; notes, shortlist and profile writes are keyed on the caller's club, and profile edits require assertEmploys.

system.routes :clubId.reason: SYSTEM is the platform owner's room: every handler asserts assertPlatformOwner (system.service / club-lifecycle.service / onboarding) before reading or changing any club.

system.routes :id.reason: Experiment decisions are platform-wide and gated by assertPlatformOwner.

system.routes :key.reason: A feature-flag key, changed only by the platform owner (assertPlatformOwner).

transfer-market.routes :interestId.reason: An interest is between two clubs; respondToInterest allows only the club that received it.

transfer-market.routes :listingId.reason: The transfer market is shared between clubs: reading another club's listing and bidding on it is the feature. Delist/cancel/extend/close check the caller's club owns the listing in the service.

transfer-market.routes :needId.reason: negotiation.service updateNeed/deleteNeed/matchesForNeed take the caller and compare the need's club.

transfer-market.routes :offerId.reason: An offer is between buying and selling clubs; negotiation.service lets only those two act on it.

transfer-market.routes :playerId.reason: Public player cards and offers are read across clubs on the market; contract, shortlist and offer-to-clubs writes are checked against the caller's club in the services.

vision.routes :id.reason: POST /cameras/:id/frame is device-signed ingest (HMAC verified by vision-ingest); GET /matches/:id/frames passes the caller's clubId into listVisionFrames' where clause.

cybersecurity.routes :domain.reason: The Cybersecurity Command Center is behind assertPlatformOwner; a domain name is a key in the security registry, not a club row.

algorithms.routes :key.reason: The Algorithms room is behind assertPlatformOwner; a key is a name in the algorithm registry, not a club row.

except.GET /system/whoami: Any signed-in user may ask whether they are the platform owner; it answers about the caller only and changes nothing.

rlsSystemPaths.platform-owner: A platform owner acts across clubs by role (authenticate); the owner rooms are pinned separately (owner-rooms-pinned).
rlsSystemPaths.transfer-settlement: An accepted offer, a purchase or a settled auction moves a player from one club to another; authorization is checked before the move.
rlsSystemPaths.staff-market-move: A completed staff move ends a membership at one club and starts it at another; both clubs agreed before it runs.
rlsSystemPaths.video-transcode: The transcode worker and its callback belong to no club; keys are confined to the asset (worker-callback-authenticated).
